Broad parser work reports strong contextual parse/identity/fuzz results but a strict-LALR blocker remains; no frontend is freeze-ready and CC-WP-02 remains open.
Operator/identifier lexical identity issue was found and repaired in a local proxy; normative parser/canonicalizer integration remains required.
Adaptive visual learner is mandatory in H1/H2/H3 with explicit trust-tier, open-set, promotion, rollback, version compatibility and budget constraints.
1000 deterministic streams x 100 transitions; trust/open-set/budget/promotion/rollback guards passed; 4/4 deliberate guard mutations killed after one preserved oracle-repair negative result.
